<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Tests\Dynamic;

use App\Service\VatCalculator;
use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;

/**
 * @internal
 */
class VatCalculatorDynamicTest extends TestCase
{
    private VatCalculator $vatCalculator;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        // Simule l'injection du taux de TVA par défaut
        $defaultVatRate = 20.0;
        $this->vatCalculator = new VatCalculator($defaultVatRate);
    }

    public function testCalculateVatAmountWithDefaultRate(): void
    {
        $netAmount = 100.0;
        $expectedVatAmount = 20.00; // 100 * 20%

        $actualVatAmount = $this->vatCalculator->calculateVatAmount($netAmount);

        $this->assertSame($expectedVatAmount, $actualVatAmount);
    }

    public function testCalculateVatAmountWithSpecificRate(): void
    {
        $netAmount = 150.0;
        $specificVatRate = 10.0;
        $expectedVatAmount = 15.00; // 150 * 10%

        $actualVatAmount = $this->vatCalculator->calculateVatAmount($netAmount, $specificVatRate);

        $this->assertSame($expectedVatAmount, $actualVatAmount);
    }

    public function testCalculateVatAmountWithZeroNetAmount(): void
    {
        $netAmount = 0.0;
        $expectedVatAmount = 0.00;

        $actualVatAmount = $this->vatCalculator->calculateVatAmount($netAmount);

        $this->assertSame($expectedVatAmount, $actualVatAmount);
    }

     public function testCalculateVatAmountWithRounding(): void
    {
        $netAmount = 123.45;
        $expectedVatAmount = 24.69; // 123.45 * 20% = 24.69

        $actualVatAmount = $this->vatCalculator->calculateVatAmount($netAmount);

        $this->assertSame($expectedVatAmount, $actualVatAmount);
    }

    public function testCalculateVatAmountThrowsExceptionForNegativeRate(): void
    {
        $this->expectException(\InvalidArgumentException::class);
        $this->expectExceptionMessage('Le taux de TVA ne peut pas être négatif.');

        $this->vatCalculator->calculateVatAmount(100.0, -10.0);
    }

    public function testCalculateGrossAmountWithDefaultRate(): void
    {
        $netAmount = 100.0;
        $expectedGrossAmount = 120.00; // 100 + (100 * 20%)

        $actualGrossAmount = $this->vatCalculator->calculateGrossAmount($netAmount);

        $this->assertSame($expectedGrossAmount, $actualGrossAmount);
    }

    public function testCalculateGrossAmountWithSpecificRate(): void
    {
        $netAmount = 200.0;
        $specificVatRate = 5.5;
        $expectedGrossAmount = 211.00; // 200 + (200 * 5.5%)

        $actualGrossAmount = $this->vatCalculator->calculateGrossAmount($netAmount, $specificVatRate);

        $this->assertSame($expectedGrossAmount, $actualGrossAmount);
    }
    
     public function testCalculateGrossAmountWithRounding(): void
    {
        $netAmount = 99.99;
        $expectedGrossAmount = 119.99; // 99.99 + (99.99 * 20%) = 119.988 -> 119.99
        $actualGrossAmount = $this->vatCalculator->calculateGrossAmount($netAmount);
        $this->assertSame($expectedGrossAmount, $actualGrossAmount);
    }

    public function testCalculateNetAmountFromGross(): void
    {
        $grossAmount = 120.0;
        $vatRate = 20.0;
        $expectedNetAmount = 100.00; // 120 / (1 + 20%/100)

        $actualNetAmount = $this->vatCalculator->calculateNetAmountFromGross($grossAmount, $vatRate);

        $this->assertSame($expectedNetAmount, $actualNetAmount);
    }

     public function testCalculateNetAmountFromGrossWithDifferentRate(): void
    {
        $grossAmount = 110.0;
        $vatRate = 10.0;
        $expectedNetAmount = 100.00; // 110 / (1 + 10%/100)

        $actualNetAmount = $this->vatCalculator->calculateNetAmountFromGross($grossAmount, $vatRate);

        $this->assertSame($expectedNetAmount, $actualNetAmount);
    }

    public function testCalculateNetAmountFromGrossWithRounding(): void
    {
        $grossAmount = 115.50;
        $vatRate = 15.0;
        $expectedNetAmount = 100.43; // 115.50 / (1 + 15%/100) = 100.43478 -> 100.43

        $actualNetAmount = $this->vatCalculator->calculateNetAmountFromGross($grossAmount, $vatRate);

        $this->assertSame($expectedNetAmount, $actualNetAmount);
    }

    public function testCalculateNetAmountFromGrossThrowsExceptionForNegativeGrossAmount(): void
    {
        $this->expectException(\InvalidArgumentException::class);
        $this->expectExceptionMessage('Le montant TTC ne peut pas être négatif.');

        $this->vatCalculator->calculateNetAmountFromGross(-100.0, 20.0);
    }
}
